findings.evidence: The email field shows only the placeholder "you@company.com" in light grey; the nearest text is the heading "Stay in the loop", with no visible field label.
findings.after: <label for="nl-email">Work email</label><input id="nl-email" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@company.com">
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions: the placeholder disappears on input and is low-contrast.

findings.evidence: Small grey captions "events in the last hour", "visit, sign up, invite", "Fewer" / "More still active" and the cohort subtitle are roughly 12px mid-grey on #f4f6f8; by eye they sit near or below 4.5:1 (not machine-verified).
findings.after: Captions at 14px minimum in the body grey used for paragraphs (or darker), verified at 4.5:1
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum); small light text is the likeliest failure on this page.

findings.where: lightest cohort cells and legend swatches; feature mini-bars
findings.evidence: The two lightest blue steps (e.g. Jul 7 week 5-7 cells, 45-47%) are very pale against the white card, and the lightest funnel bar under "visit, sign up, invite" is pale blue on grey; the cell values are printed, but the mini-bars carry no numbers.
findings.before: Lightest ramp step close to the card white; unlabelled pale bars
findings.after: Start the ramp at a step with 3:1 against white (or add a 1px cell border), and label the funnel bars with their values
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast for data marks.

strengths: Cohort heatmap prints the percentage in every cell, so the data is not conveyed by colour alone (1.4.1).
Primary text and buttons are dark navy on light grey or white text on navy, both high contrast.
not_investigated: Image-only item: a11y lens limited to what is visible. Not checked: alt text, accessible names, focus visibility and order, keyboard operation, headings and landmarks, lang/title, reflow at 320px, motion, form errors.
Contrast values estimated by eye from the screenshot, not measured.
